result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Customer may terminate on 30 days' written notice and receive a refund of prepaid fees attributable to the post-termination period, while Kubient may terminate for convenience only at the end of the then-current term on 90 days' notice. However, permitting termination of any Exhibit, in whole or in part, materially expands Customer's rights beyond what the playbook requires and may disrupt unrelated scope and pricing arrangements. The drafting is otherwise clear, though the retained sentence regarding fees during the 'termination period' could be clarified to avoid tension with the refund obligation.
